radar.title: AFRL AMAC — $10B Multiple-Award S&T IDIQ
radar.sub: AFRL PROCUREMENT HQ (PK), WPAFB · UNCLASSIFIED S&T, ALL DIRECTORATES

cells.label: Timeline
cells.html: Draft RFP Dec 19 2025 → solicitation FA8652-26-R-0001 (Jan 2026, proposals due Feb 27) → GAO protests dismissed Apr 6 → solicitation canceled Apr 13 2026, no proposals evaluated → revived as draft FA8652-26-R-0006 (May 14 2026, industry responses due Jun 15). As of Oct 2026 a reworked final RFP had not been confirmed released — verify current FA8652 notices on SAM.gov.

cells.label: Structure
cells.html: 5-yr base + three 1-yr options; $500 minimum guarantee per awardee; dollars flow only through later task/delivery orders (FFP, CPFF). OASIS+ considered as a model.

cells.label: Scope
cells.html: Basic/applied research, data science & analytics, digital architecture, modeling & sim, experimentation, tech transition. Revived notice names four areas incl. cybersecurity and multi-domain ops. Excludes consulting/A&AS.

cells.label: Small-firm angle
cells.html: The April reset re-opened the field. Primes must file a mandatory Small Business Participation Commitment Document — structural teaming demand for small firms while capture teams rebuild.

radar.sources: SAM.gov (FA8652-26-R-0001 cancellation; FA8652-26-R-0006 draft) · GovConWire · Baker Tilly · orangeslices.ai protest tracker

radar.title: AFRL Adversary System-of-Systems Analysis — ~$1B R&D
radar.sub: ANNOUNCED JAN 2026 · CLOSEST PUBLISHED LANE TO ADVERSARY-ANALYSIS WORK

cells.label: What is known
cells.html: AFRL announced plans in early Jan 2026 to compete a potential $1B contract for R&D on adversary system-of-systems analysis supporting the Air Force. Details beyond the announcement were not confirmed in sources reviewed.

cells.label: Why it matters
cells.html: Adversary system-of-systems analysis characterizes how adversary capabilities interconnect — the one published WPAFB vehicle family where threat-finance and procurement-network analysis would naturally fit.

cells.label: Watch for
cells.html: Current status on SAM.gov (search: adversary system-of-systems analysis AFRL). If solicited, the eventual primes become the subcontracting surface for specialist analytic niches.

radar.sources: GovConWire (Jan 2026, single mention) — verify before acting

radar.title: NASIC A&AS IDIQ — $866M
radar.sub: APOGEE · KBR WYLE · RIVERSIDE · SPA · ORDERING THROUGH JUN 2034

cells.label: State of play
cells.html: Awarded May 2026 by AFLCMC (four offers received; $20K obligated at award). Task orders compete among the four awardees for eight years. Ceiling ≠ money — obligations accrue order by order, and intel-support order descriptions are often vague or unlisted.

cells.label: Recompete horizon
cells.html: months of ordering runway remain. The serious recompete window opens ~2032–2033; the hiring window is open now and continuous.

cells.label: Market signal
cells.html: Eight years of funded analyst demand in one metro. The four awardees’ capture teams are the subcontract door as individual task orders drop; apprentice-level postings (Apogee) show hiring reaches entry level.

radar.sources: DoD announcement via Dayton Daily News, May 2026

radar.title: UDRI — $850M AF Rapid Problem-Solving
radar.sub: UNIVERSITY OF DAYTON RESEARCH INSTITUTE · AWARDED MAR 2026

cells.label: What is known
cells.html: $850M Air Force contract for rapid problem-solving R&D, announced Mar 2026. Period of performance and ordering mechanics were not confirmed in sources reviewed — verify on USASpending once the award record posts.

cells.label: Market signal
cells.html: UDRI subcontracts and hires locally; a fresh $850M vehicle implies staffing demand through 2026–2027.

cells.label: Mechanics
cells.html: Phase I ~$75K/3mo (customer discovery) → Phase II ≤$1.25M/21mo → STRATFI/TACFI $375K–$15M. D2P2 available with a signed Customer Memorandum.

cells.label: Small-firm angle
cells.html: The standing sole-practitioner rail into DAF R&D. Next Open Topic window posts on DSIP; the DARPA–Inca award is the precedent that DoD buys digital-asset threat-finance R&D from small firms.
